description: This file defines the class Zend_Loader_Autoloader, which implements a singleton autoloader stack for dynamically loading PHP classes within the Zend Framework, including namespace handling, callback management, and version path retrieval.

classes.name: Zend_Loader_Autoloader
classes.description: The Zend_Loader_Autoloader class implements a singleton pattern for managing a stack of class autoload callbacks, supporting namespace-specific autoloaders, fallback mechanisms, and version path handling within the Zend Framework.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Retrieves the singleton instance of the autoloader.

methods.name: resetInstance
methods.description: Resets the singleton instance to null.

methods.name: autoload
methods.description: Attempts to load a class using the registered autoloaders.

methods.name: setDefaultAutoloader
methods.description: Sets the callback used as the default autoloader.

methods.name: getDefaultAutoloader
methods.description: Returns the current default autoloader callback.

methods.name: setAutoloaders
methods.description: Sets multiple autoloader callbacks.

methods.name: getAutoloaders
methods.description: Returns all registered autoloader callbacks.

methods.name: getNamespaceAutoloaders
methods.description: Returns autoloaders registered for a specific namespace.

methods.name: registerNamespace
methods.description: Registers a namespace or list of namespaces for autoloading.

methods.name: unregisterNamespace
methods.description: Unregisters a namespace or list of namespaces.

methods.name: getRegisteredNamespaces
methods.description: Returns all registered namespaces.

methods.name: setZfPath
methods.description: Sets the path for Zend Framework files, managing versioning.

methods.name: getZfPath
methods.description: Retrieves the current Zend Framework installation path.

methods.name: suppressNotFoundWarnings
methods.description: Gets or sets whether to suppress warnings when class files are not found.

methods.name: setFallbackAutoloader
methods.description: Designates whether this autoloader should act as a fallback.

methods.name: isFallbackAutoloader
methods.description: Checks if autoloader is set as fallback.

methods.name: getClassAutoloaders
methods.description: Determines and returns the autoloaders applicable for a specific class based on namespace.

methods.name: unshiftAutoloader
methods.description: Adds an autoloader callback to the beginning of the stack.

methods.name: pushAutoloader
methods.description: Adds an autoloader callback to the end of the stack.

methods.name: removeAutoloader
methods.description: Removes an autoloader callback from the stack, optionally limiting to specific namespaces.

methods.name: _autoload
methods.description: Internal autoload implementation called by spl_autoload_register.

methods.name: _setNamespaceAutoloaders
methods.description: Associates autoloaders with a specific namespace.

methods.name: _getVersionPath
methods.description: Computes the filesystem path for a specific version of Zend Framework.

methods.name: _getVersionType
methods.description: Determines whether a version string is latest, major, minor, or specific.

methods.name: _getAvailableVersions
methods.description: Finds available Zend Framework versions in a directory.
